Title: Retrieve appointments with default pagination (page 0, limit 10) for a shop on a specific date
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists and has at least 15 appointment reservations recorded for 2023-11-01
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK). Response body contains an ApiResponse with status 'SUCCESS', message 'Appointments retrieved successfully', data containing a paginated list of up to 10 appointments, and meta with totalRecords=15, currentPage=0, totalPages=2.

Title: Retrieve appointments with custom page size (boundary: size 1) for a shop on a specific date
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists and has at least 3 appointment reservations recorded for 2023-11-01
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK). Response body contains an ApiResponse with status 'SUCCESS', message 'Appointments retrieved successfully', data containing a paginated list of exactly 1 appointment, and meta with totalRecords=3, currentPage=0, totalPages=3.

Title: Retrieve appointments with custom page size (boundary: size 0) for a shop on a specific date
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists and has at least 1 appointment reservation recorded for 2023-11-01
Expected Result: HTTP status code 400 (Bad Request). Response body contains an error message indicating that the limit must be greater than zero.

Title: Retrieve appointments with custom page size (boundary: size 1000, very large input) for a shop on a specific date
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists and has 500 appointment reservations recorded for 2023-11-01
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK). Response body contains an ApiResponse with status 'SUCCESS', message 'Appointments retrieved successfully', data containing a paginated list of up to 1000 appointments, and meta with totalRecords=500, currentPage=0, totalPages=1.

Title: Retrieve appointments with custom page number (boundary: page -1, one below minimum) for a shop on a specific date
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists and has at least 1 appointment reservation recorded for 2023-11-01
Expected Result: HTTP status code 400 (Bad Request). Response body contains an error message indicating that the page number must be zero or greater.

Title: Retrieve appointments with custom page number (boundary: page 0, exactly at minimum) for a shop on a specific date
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists and has at least 1 appointment reservation recorded for 2023-11-01
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK). Response body contains an ApiResponse with status 'SUCCESS', message 'Appointments retrieved successfully', data containing a paginated list of appointments, and meta with currentPage=0.

Title: Retrieve appointments with custom page number (boundary: page 999, very large input) for a shop on a specific date
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists and has 10 appointment reservations recorded for 2023-11-01
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK). Response body contains an ApiResponse with status 'SUCCESS', message 'Appointments retrieved successfully', data containing an empty paginated list, and meta with totalRecords=10, currentPage=999, totalPages=1.

Title: Retrieve appointments with no appointments recorded for the given date (boundary: empty result set)
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists and has no appointment reservations recorded for 2023-11-02
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK). Response body contains an ApiResponse with status 'SUCCESS', message 'Appointments retrieved successfully', data containing an empty paginated list, and meta with totalRecords=0, currentPage=0, totalPages=0.

Title: Retrieve appointments for a non-existent shop (boundary: invalid shop ID)
Expected Result: HTTP status code 404 (Not Found). Response body contains an error message: 'Shop not found'.

Title: Retrieve appointments with a very large shop ID (boundary: large numeric input)
Expected Result: HTTP status code 404 (Not Found). Response body contains an error message: 'Shop not found'.

Title: Retrieve appointments with search criteria using worker ID and date (boundary: valid worker ID and date)
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists, worker with ID 1 exists, and has at least 3 appointment reservations recorded for 2023-11-01 with worker ID 1
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK). Response body contains a paginated list of appointments for worker ID 1 on 2023-11-01, with pagination metadata.

Title: Retrieve appointments with search criteria using customer phone and date (boundary: valid phone and date)
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists and has at least 2 appointment reservations recorded for 2023-11-01 with customer phone '1234567890'
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK). Response body contains a paginated list of appointments for customer phone '1234567890' on 2023-11-01, with pagination metadata.

Title: Retrieve appointments with search criteria using customer name and date (boundary: valid name and date)
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists and has at least 2 appointment reservations recorded for 2023-11-01 with customer name 'John Doe'
Steps: 1. Send a GET request to /api/shops/1/appointments/search?customerName=John Doe&date=2023-11-01&page=0&limit=10
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK). Response body contains a paginated list of appointments for customer name 'John Doe' on 2023-11-01, with pagination metadata.

Title: Retrieve appointments with search criteria using customer phone only (boundary: missing date)
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists and has at least 1 appointment reservation recorded with customer phone '1234567890'
Expected Result: HTTP status code 400 (Bad Request). Response body contains an error message indicating that the date is required.

Title: Retrieve appointments with search criteria using an empty customer phone (boundary: empty string)
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists and has at least 1 appointment reservation recorded for 2023-11-01
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK). Response body contains a paginated list of all appointments for 2023-11-01, with pagination metadata.

Title: Retrieve appointments with search criteria using a very long customer phone (boundary: large string input)
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists and has at least 1 appointment reservation recorded for 2023-11-01
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK). Response body contains a paginated list of appointments matching the long customer phone (if any) or an empty list, with pagination metadata.

Title: Retrieve customer appointments with default pagination (page 0, limit 10)
Preconditions: Customer with username 'john.doe' exists and has at least 15 appointment reservations recorded
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK). Response body contains a paginated list of up to 10 appointment reservations for customer 'john.doe', with pagination metadata (totalRecords=15, currentPage=0, totalPages=2).

Title: Retrieve customer appointments with custom page size (boundary: size 1)
Preconditions: Customer with username 'john.doe' exists and has at least 3 appointment reservations recorded
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK). Response body contains a paginated list of exactly 1 appointment reservation for customer 'john.doe', with pagination metadata (totalRecords=3, currentPage=0, totalPages=3).

Title: Retrieve customer appointments with no appointments recorded (boundary: empty result set)
Preconditions: Customer with username 'jane.doe' exists and has no appointment reservations recorded
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 (OK). Response body contains an empty paginated list, with pagination metadata (totalRecords=0, currentPage=0, totalPages=0).
